summary: Made agents reliably close PR review threads: added a token-gated resolve-addressed-threads.yml workflow that resolves a thread via GraphQL only when its latest comment carries a disposition token (Addressed in <sha> when fixed, Resolving: <reason> when declined as incorrect/irrelevant), plus a comment-resolution-policy.md contract and AGENTS.md/copilot-instructions/reviewer-persona updates that force agents to emit the reason.
